actionable_steps.citation: No one can escape the consequences of their actions — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-08-15
actionable_steps.step: Before you act, enquire: is this action befitting a human being? A moment of enquiry now saves years of consequence later.

actionable_steps.citation: Sathya Sai Gita (iv) — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 1 (1953 - 60), 1960-09-30
actionable_steps.step: Do good karma to assuage the pain of bad karma done before — a thorn is removed only by means of another thorn.

actionable_steps.citation: Sathya Sai Gita (iv) — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 1 (1953 - 60), 1960-09-30
actionable_steps.step: Take up the best and simplest karma: repetition of the Name of the Lord. It keeps out evil tendencies and wicked thoughts.

actionable_steps.citation: Revolutions, resolutions — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 10 (1970), 1970-01-14
actionable_steps.step: Offer every action at the Feet of God instead of chasing its fruit — then the action glorifies Him and cannot bind you.

actionable_steps.citation: The inner motivator — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 24 (1991), 1991-05-25
actionable_steps.step: Don't be fooled when bad actions seem to go unpunished — their fruit ripens like a tree, in due course. Walk the virtuous path anyway.

definition.citation: No one can escape the consequences of their actions — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-08-15
definition.quote: What is karma? It is the action that we perform. … As the action, so is the result. No one can escape from the consequences of his actions.

discourses.citation: All are bound by the law of karma by — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 38 (2005), 2005-03-09
discourses.quote: Everyone has to face the consequences of one's own karma. … Whatever pleasure or pain undergone by a living being is certainly the outcome of the karmas (action) performed by it.

discourses.citation: Develop intense devotion — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 32 (1999), 1999-09-03
discourses.quote: Every action has a reaction. … The consequence of one's actions are inevitable. … But, know for sure that none can escape the consequences of their actions.

discourses.citation: Revolutions, resolutions — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 10 (1970), 1970-01-14
discourses.quote: The Law of Karma holds out hope for you, as the karma, so the consequence. Do not bind yourself further by seeking the fruit of karma, offer the karma at the Feet of God; let it glorify Him; let it further His splendour.

discourses.citation: The inner motivator — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 24 (1991), 1991-05-25
discourses.quote: It taught them about the inexorable, immutable and inescapable law of Karma, duly stressing the fact that the results of good or bad actions are not like the milk that you get immediately as you draw it from the udder of a milch cow, but they are like the fruits that you get from a tree long after the seed is planted.

make_it_real: Every action has a reaction — so make today's action one you'd be glad to meet again.
title: Karma

vahinis.quote: Karma is not simply physical; it is mental, verbal, and manual. … Karma means movement, or that which urges the movement.
